status: EXPLORATORY INPUTS; calculations, CAD and independent verification not yet performed
scope: Compare thin-CFRP tripod and quadpod legs, and CFRP versus aluminium single spine. No fabrication release, actuation-concept change, PID tuning or physical acceptance.

provenance.recovered_measurement_method: Reviewed r8_solid_fixture_01.py through current tool_result 8db724a8a01a418b9f78c88439591448 revision 1. Reuse measurement of individual Part.Solid objects and unsaved native parameter probes; do not reuse its historical authorization or fixture dimensions as vehicle inputs.
provenance.headless_diagnosis: Human source 6461e706a0c84ff394997606ff098cdb revision 1. GUI RPC unavailable; headless execution does not require the addon. Generic Shape mass-property access failed; use individual solids and fresh filenames.
provenance.historical_inputs: The reviewed r10 input file supplies recovery context only. Its geometry, aluminium-only assumptions, ownership and stale embedded references are not adopted.
provenance.reference_designs: Completed supplied read d11d0157b77b4411b89f9bc5d704ff3c revision 1 is qualitative precedent only. Photos were not inspected and supply no numerical inputs.
provenance.supplier_coordination: Propulsion peer request bc007e46b24943bcbf6d2c43b3b8f309 is outstanding. No response or current supplier stock evidence is assumed here.

frame_contract.cad_origin: Neutral spine-axis intersection with nominal uncompressed level-ground plane
frame_contract.datum_rule: O_B0 is fixed at the complete neutral vehicle CG after that CG is established. Neither CAD origin nor a partial structural CG substitutes for it.
frame_contract.inertia_rule: Density-weight raw solid inertia in mm^5 by rho*1e-15, aggregate about the relevant CG using parallel-axis terms, then rotate the full tensor. An inertia already in kg mm^2 instead uses 1e-6.

comparison_design.support_inradius_formula: r = R*cos(pi/n), for the polygon of point foot centres
report: Foot-centre coordinates, circumdiameter, directional spans, support-polygon area and minimum inradius
Tube cut length, installed tube-only mass, whole-stock quantity, kerf, end trim and unused stock
Full-contact, first-foot and incomplete-contact cases without assuming equal load sharing
Equivalent axial/bending/buckling indicators under identical explicitly stated loads and restraint assumptions
Spine mass and stiffness comparisons at equal section and length; no assumption of equal material strength
Rotor, structure and ground clearance limitations; no leg-count recommendation based only on mass

leg_geometry_hypotheses.leg_centreline: Straight radial segment from attachment point to foot centre at the same azimuth; cut length initially equals centreline length, before actual joint insertion allowances
leg_geometry_hypotheses.section_status: Generic geometric sensitivities, not evidence that these sections or laminates are purchasable

spine_comparison_hypotheses.basis: Equal geometry first. The recovered 16x1 mm screening section is not a selected current aluminium stock specification. Actual stock alternatives and equivalent-stiffness options require supplier reconciliation.
spine_comparison_hypotheses.battery_and_avionics: Must remain above both rotor envelopes; placements and mounting masses are not specified by this tube-only comparison.

CFRP-SENSITIVITY.status: Assumed sensitivity values only; independent modulus sweeps are not a laminate constitutive model

ALUMINIUM-SENSITIVITY.status: Nominal analytical assumptions, not verified purchased alloy/temper properties

load_sensitivities.reference_mass_status: Load-case hypotheses only, not computed or selected vehicle mass
load_sensitivities.load_multiplier_status: Comparison factors, not an impact simulation or agreed design load
contact_cases: all feet with explicitly ideal equal vertical load
one foot takes the full prescribed load
quadpod supported on only three feet
restraint_cases: Ideal axial strut: requires compatible lateral contact forces, friction and joints; calculate required horizontal reactions rather than assuming them available
Clamped-root end-loaded member with specified vertical and horizontal foot forces: resolve axial and transverse loads and calculate bending indicators
Euler column indicators with K=1 and K=2; not a local-shell-buckling or joint-strength acceptance check
load_sensitivities.acceptance_rule: Report demand and model sensitivity only; no structural safety pass while allowables, joints and landing loads are unresolved.

kinematic_envelope_sensitivities.diameter_status: 11-inch and 13-inch geometric cases; no propeller or propulsion selection
kinematic_envelope_sensitivities.joint_domain: Independent rectangular alpha/beta domain, including simultaneous extremes; not a resultant tilt cone
kinematic_envelope_sensitivities.status: All values are screening hypotheses, not accepted travel or physical clearances. Zero allowance is a nominal baseline only.
kinematic_envelope_sensitivities.mechanical_topology: Retain the common two-axis gimbal. Pivot-to-rotor offsets here describe only rigid kinematics; actual bearing, motor-carrier, shaft, harness and linkage paths remain to be demonstrated without crossing blade envelopes.
kinematic_envelope_sensitivities.verification_distinction: Separate nominal CAD distances and sampled joint-domain results from conservative continuous-domain bounds. Bounds must identify their covering geometry, domain and numerical margin. Preserve unmodelled blade flexibility, tube/joint deformation, tolerances and settling limitations.
kinematic_envelope_sensitivities.conflict_rule: If a required layout conflicts with the retained actuation concept, report to Chief/human; do not substitute another concept.

cutting_stock_sensitivities.status: Assumed cutting sensitivity only. Supplier nominal/usable lengths, minimum packs, dimensional tolerances and tool process remain unverified.
cutting_stock_sensitivities.purchase_rule: Charge whole minimum purchasable stock/packs after supplier reconciliation; never prorate installed length. Count leg and spine cuts together only for identical supplier stock variants. Include non-exempt joints, adhesive and retention hardware.

mass_and_interface_rules.stationary_group: Spine, fixed attachment ring/plate, landing legs and fixed equipment; individual assignments pending
mass_and_interface_rules.outer_gimbal_group: Members carried by Rx(alpha), including any outer-mounted actuator; individual assignments pending
mass_and_interface_rules.inner_gimbal_group: Common carrier and non-spinning motor portions carried by Rx(alpha)Ry(beta); individual assignments pending
mass_and_interface_rules.rotating_groups: Separate upper and lower propellers and motor rotating portions; catalogue motor mass must not be double-counted when rotor/stator split is unknown
mass_and_interface_rules.commercial_inertia: Unknown unless supplied or measured; any homogeneous-envelope approximation must be separately labelled
mass_and_interface_rules.swept_envelopes: Nonphysical clearance geometry; exclude from mass and inertia
mass_and_interface_rules.partial_mass_rule: Report tube-only or custom-part subtotals explicitly. Do not label these complete vehicle mass, CG or inertia.

execution_and_evidence.cad_execution: Saved scripts through freecad_run(headless=True) only; declare every export and use fresh output names after partial failures
execution_and_evidence.measurement: Reopen native and STEP artifacts, enumerate valid individual solids, retain component identities, density-weight their properties and test native parameter edits/recompute without modifying baseline artifacts
execution_and_evidence.independent_checks: Retain editable programs using actual artifact inputs. verify_command stdout must contain only VerificationResult JSON; diagnostics on stderr; include every tested current artifact Ref in tool inputs.
execution_and_evidence.recommendation_gate: Send numerical comparisons and bounded recommendations to Chief before treating any dimensions, leg count or material as selected.
